historical_record.description: The building held a laundry and cleaning establishment, a commercial use left nonconforming in a residential district and due to end in 1970.
The City Planning Commission approved, with conditions, extending the life of the nonconforming use (laundry and cleaning establishment) to May 2, 1980.
The City Planning Commission did not take Discretionary Review and approved the demolition of the existing one-story residential unit with commercial space.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the new construction of a four-story, four-unit building, with conditions.
